categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production and sales of pyrotechnic products and related items. It operates two main business segments: military products (including military pyrotechnic elements, devices, training materials, and meteorological rockets) and civilian products (including weather modification equipment, meteorological monitoring devices, and related software). The company also develops dual-use technology products and extends into digital economy fields such as smart funeral services, smart factories, and smart water management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology centers on pyrotechnic drug formulations and manufacturing processes. It utilizes advanced production techniques including automated and intelligent production lines for pyrotechnic materials, employs electronic technology, artificial intelligence, IoT, and satellite positioning in product development. The company has established automated production lines for initiating drugs and comprehensive video monitoring systems for safety production. For weather modification equipment, it integrates detection, command, and operational capabilities into integrated systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Military customers include the Chinese military (Army, Navy, Air Force, Rocket Force, and Strategic Support Force) as well as public security and armed police forces. Civilian customers are primarily meteorological departments across more than 20 provinces and autonomous regions in China, with cooperative relationships established with nearly 1,000 counties and districts. The company also serves the defense industry supply chain and participates in military trade exports through authorized military trade companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China, with headquarters in Xinyu City, Jiangxi Province. It maintains operations across multiple provinces through its weather modification business relationships with meteorological departments nationwide. The company has established a subsidiary in Nanjing (South Jiangsu) for software development and technical support. International presence is limited, with military product exports conducted through authorized military trade companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at the midstream to downstream positions in the supply chain. For military products, it serves as a critical component supplier to major weapons system integrators and military equipment manufacturers. For civilian weather modification products, it functions as both a manufacturer and service provider, supplying equipment and materials directly to meteorological departments and end-users. The company also provides integrated solutions and system-level services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes advancing from second and third-generation pyrotechnic products toward fourth and fifth-generation products to match international standards. In weather modification, it focuses on transitioning from ground-based operations toward air-based operations using manned and unmanned aircraft. R&D priorities include developing integrated, intelligent, and automated weather modification systems, advancing catalyst dispersal methods, enhancing safety technologies, and expanding into digital economy applications including smart meteorology, smart environmental monitoring, and emergency response systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of manufactured products. Military products are sold directly to weapons system integrators and military enterprises through annual procurement conferences and bidding processes. Civilian weather modification products are sold through government procurement channels, with prices referenced to agreements established by the China Meteorological Administration. The company also generates revenue from software development, technical services, and integrated system solutions. Government subsidies and grants provide supplementary income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In military pyrotechnic products, the company competes with subsidiaries of China North Industries Group and China North Industries Group Corporation, which have stronger technical capabilities and production scales. In weather modification, primary competitors include China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation's Zhongtian Rocket and China North Industries Group. The company ranks among the top in domestic market share for weather modification rockets and maintains the most comprehensive product variety among domestic pyrotechnic specialists. It holds important industry status with strong brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized defense technology enterprise with 2023 revenue of 388.6 million yuan, representing 14.05% growth from 340.7 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 75.7 million yuan in 2023, up 14.07% from 66.4 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 764.7 million yuan at year-end 2023, up 11.10% from 688.2 million yuan in 2022. The company demonstrates consistent double-digit growth with improving profitability and cash generation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through comprehensive product portfolios covering the complete weather modification value chain from detection to operation to management. It offers integrated, intelligent, and automated solutions that competitors cannot match. The company emphasizes product reliability, safety, and technical sophistication, with many products certified by the China Meteorological Administration. Its competitive advantages include decades of industry experience, strong R&D capabilities, established relationships with military and meteorological customers, and integration of advanced technologies including AI, IoT, and cloud computing into traditional products.
